headline: Itaú Colombia Posts $145 Million Q3 Loss After Selling Retail Unit
summary: Itaú Colombia recorded a net loss of roughly $145 million in the third quarter of 2026 following the divestment of its consumer banking operations to Banco de Bogotá.
why: Itaú Unibanco is Latin America's largest private bank; reshaping its Andean presence by shedding retail units reflects a broader regional pivot toward corporate banking.

impacts.name: Banco Itaú Colombia
impacts.why: Accounting costs and adjustments from the retail banking divestiture generated a $145M quarterly loss.
